title: A Noetherian ring is a G-ring exactly when every finite free extension has regular formal fibres
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma replaces the G-ring condition by a test over finite free extensions, and the proof is a 35-line argument that transports regularity of formal fibres across such an extension. Given primes q inside p and a finite purely inseparable extension of the residue field, it chooses a finite free extension of the ring realising that extension at a prime over q, uses the product decomposition of the completion after a finite extension to write the algebra to be tested as a product of completed local rings of the extension, and reads regularity off the hypothesis; the converse is quoted from the statement that the G-ring property goes up along quasi-finite maps. The construction of the finite free extension and the product decomposition are the two steps with content, and both are displayed.
